title: Implementation and Software-in-the-Loop Evaluation of a Trans-Domain Digital Twin Architecture for Autonomous Guidance of the Phoenix VTOL UAV Without Online GNSS
abstract: arXiv:2611.29158v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous UAV guidance in emergency response, infrastructure monitoring, and cargo transportation requires reliable navigation. However, satellite-based positioning may become unavailable or unreliable in enclosed spaces, blind spots caused by natural obstacles and structures, and environments affected by radio interference and signal spoofing during electronic warfare. This study designs, implements, and evaluates a system based on a Trans-Domain Digital Twin (TDDT) for autonomous guidance of the Phoenix VTOL UAV. Independent navigation, flight dynamics, and meteorological models are coordinated within a cycle of state estimation, prediction, decision-making, command execution, and feedback. Data from inertial, magnetic, pressure, and airspeed sensors, together with environmental information, form the basis for estimation and prediction. translated_title: 无在线GNSS条件下凤凰号垂直起降无人机跨域数字孪生自主制导架构的实现与软件在环评估
translated_abstract: 在应急救援、基础设施监测和货物运输中的自主无人机制导需要可靠的导航。然而，在封闭空间、由自然障碍物和建筑物造成的盲区，以及受电子战中无线电干扰和信号欺骗影响的环境里，基于卫星的定位可能变得不可用或不可靠。本研究设计、实现并评估了一个基于跨域数字孪生（TDDT）的系统，用于凤凰号垂直起降无人机的自主制导。独立的导航模型、飞行动力学模型和气象模型在状态估计、预测、决策制定、指令执行和反馈的循环中协同工作。来自惯性、磁力、压力和空速传感器的数据，结合环境信息，构成了估计与预测的基础。此外，共享状态、时间同步、信息来源的保存以及……
tldr: 本研究设计并实现了基于跨域数字孪生（TDDT）架构的凤凰号垂直起降无人机自主制导系统，在无在线GNSS条件下通过导航、飞行动力学与气象多模型协同及多传感器数据融合实现可靠导航，并通过软件在环仿真进行了评估验证。
en_tdlr: This study designs, implements, and evaluates a Trans-Domain Digital Twin (TDDT) architecture for autonomous guidance of the Phoenix VTOL UAV without online GNSS, achieving reliable navigation through coordinated navigation, flight dynamics, and meteorological models with multi-sensor fusion, validated via software-in-the-loop simulation.
